member.name: T:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode
member.summary: Specifies how resources should be added to or removed from a MultiResourceStorage component.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.InOrder
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the order listed until each in turn is full. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in the order listed until each in turn is empty.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.InReverseOrder
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the reverse of the order listed until each in turn is full. When removing: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the reverse of the order listed until each in turn is empty.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.PrioritizeMostEmptyCapacity
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the order of most remaining capacity first until all storages have the same remaining capacity, after which the resources will be distributed evenly across all storages. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in the order of most remaining capacity first until each in turn is empty.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.PrioritizeLeastEmptyCapacity
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the order of least remaining capacity first until each in turn is full. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in the order of least remaining capacity first until all storages have the same remaining capacity, after which the resources will be removed evenly across all storages.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.PrioritizeMostResources
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the order of most resources first until each in turn is full. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in the order of most resources first until all storages have the same amount of resources, after which the resources will be removed evenly across all storages.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.PrioritizeLeastResources
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in the order of least resources first until all storages have the same amount of resources, after which the resources will be distributed evenly across all storages. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in the order of least resources first until each in turn is empty.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.DistributeEvenly
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in as equally-sized portions as possible. Any units of resources that can't be evenly divided will be added to storages in the order listed. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in as equally-sized portions as possible. Any units of resources that can't be evenly divided will be removed from the storages in the reverse of the order listed.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.DistributeRandomly
member.summary: When adding: Resources will be added to the resource storages in random order until each in turn is full. When removing: Resources will be removed from the resource storages in random order until each in turn is empty.

member.name: F:Cosmoteer.Ships.Parts.Resources.MultiResourceStorageMode.DistributeProportionallyByAvailable

member.summary: Focuses the camera on the specified object.
member.param: If false, the existing focus targets will be removed and replaced with the specified target. If true, the specified target will be added to the existing targets.
If true, plays a sound effect.
If true, focus on the specified target will be canceled once the view has reached the target.

If true, the current FrameOfReference will be cleared.
